newsitem.title: USA: Culbro Corp stake cut by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Culbro Corp stake cut by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Thursday it cut its stake in Culbro Corp to 971,800 common shares or 21.54 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 37,000 sold between December 27, 1996 and February 18, 1997 at prices ranging from $62.3444 to $77.50 per share.

Culbro, based in New York, is a diversified organization with interests in cigars, wholesale distribution of tobacco and sundry consumer products, industrial products including labeling systems, and packaging machinery, real estate and landscape nursery stock.
